# GENERATED by gearbox <version> -- do not edit. Run `gearbox generate` to regenerate.

server:
  home_dir: /var/lib/gearbox
database:
  servers:
    pg:
      engine: postgres
      host: postgres.configurable.svc.cluster.local
      port: 5432
      user: configurable
      password: ${GEARS_PG_PASSWORD}
permissions:
  events.consume:
  - "*"
  events.producers.manage:
  - "*"
  events.publish:
  - "*"
  events.topics.read:
  - "*"
  events.types.read:
  - "*"
gears:
  api-gateway:
    config:
      bind_addr: 0.0.0.0:8087
  authn-resolver:
    config: {}
  authz-resolver:
    config: {}
  cluster:
    config:
      profiles:
        event-broker:
          cache:
            connection_string: postgres://configurable@${PG_HOST}:5432/configurable?password=${PG_PASSWORD}
            provider: postgres
            schema: cluster
            secret_ref:
              name: env:PG_PASSWORD
          lock:
            provider: postgres
            secret_ref:
              name: env:PG_PASSWORD
  event-broker:
    database:
      server: pg
      dbname: event_broker
    config:
      {}
  grpc-hub:
    config:
      listen_addr: 0.0.0.0:50051
  static-authz-plugin:
    config: {}
  static-tr-plugin:
    config: {}
  tenant-resolver:
    config: {}
  types-registry:
    database:
      server: pg
      dbname: types_registry
    config:
      {}

        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}

        - name: api-gateway
          {{- $registry := .Values.image.registry }}

            - "gbx-api-gateway"

              protocol: TCP

              valueFrom:

              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:

            {{- if and .Values.existingSecret .Values.secretKeys }}

            {{- end }}

=== helm/configurable-gears/values.generated.yaml
# GENERATED by gearbox <version> -- do not edit. Run `gearbox generate` to regenerate.

global:
  commonLabels: {}
  commonAnnotations: {}
api-gateway:
  database:
    existingSecret: configurable-db
    passwordEnv: GEARS_PG_PASSWORD
  enabled: true
  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    registry: registry.example.com/configurable
    repository: gbx-api-gateway
    tag: 0.1.0
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  serviceAccount:
    create: true
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 65532
    fsGroup: 65532
  containerSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    seccompProfile:
      type: RuntimeDefault
    capabilities:
      drop:
      - ALL
  livenessProbe:
    enabled: true
    initialDelaySeconds: 0
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold: 3
  readinessProbe:
    enabled: true
    initialDelaySeconds: 0
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold: 3
    successThreshold: 1
  startupProbe:
    enabled: false
    initialDelaySeconds: 0
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold: 30
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
  homeVolume:
    type: emptyDir
  automountServiceAccountToken: false
  tokenReview: false
  custom: {}
  secretKeys:
  - PG_HOST
  - PG_PASSWORD

{
  "$comment": "GENERATED by gearbox <version> -- do not edit. Run `gearbox generate` to regenerate.",
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "api-gateway": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "affinity": true,
        "automountServiceAccountToken": {
          "description": "Whether the pod gets a Kubernetes API token mounted.\n\n`false`, which is a hardening rather than an inconvenience: nothing in a\ngenerated topology talks to the API server. The runtime's resolver set is\nDirectory, Null and Static -- the absence of a cluster-native one is what\nGBX0603 reports -- so the token would be an unused credential inside every\npod, which is the kind of thing a policy scanner is right to flag.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "commonAnnotations": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"

          "description": "Annotations for this subchart's resources only.",
          "type": [
            "object",
            "null"
          ]
        },

          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "Labels for this subchart's resources only.\n\nThe narrower half of the pair: `global.commonLabels` covers the product,\nthis covers one process. Both are merged on top of the standard\n`app.kubernetes.io/*` set rather than replacing it -- a policy label and a\nselector label are not competing for the same slot.",
          "type": [
            "object",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "containerSecurityContext": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "description": "The container's security context. Open for the same reason.",
              "properties": {
                "allowPrivilegeEscalation": {
                  "type": "boolean"
                },
                "capabilities": {
                  "properties": {
                    "drop": {
                      "description": "`ALL`, in capitals, because the admission controller compares case-sensitively.\n\nThe template this replaced wrote `all`. Pod Security Admission matches the\ndropped capability against the literal `ALL`, so a chart carrying the\nlowercase spelling is refused by the very `restricted` profile it was\nwritten to satisfy -- while looking, in a diff, exactly right.",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "type": "array"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "drop"
                  ],
                  "type": "object"
                },
                "readOnlyRootFilesystem": {
                  "type": "boolean"
                },
                "runAsNonRoot": {
                  "type": "boolean"
                },
                "seccompProfile": {
                  "properties": {
                    "type": {
                      "description": "Serialized as `type`, which is a Rust keyword.",
                      "type": "string"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "type"
                  ],
                  "type": "object"
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "runAsNonRoot",
                "readOnlyRootFilesystem",
                "allowPrivilegeEscalation",
                "seccompProfile",
                "capabilities"
              ],
              "type": "object"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "The container's security context. Same reasoning, worse starting point.\n\nThis one had no `.Values` escape at all: the template called the helper\nunconditionally, so `readOnlyRootFilesystem` and the dropped capabilities\nwere not adjustable by any means short of a replacement template."
        },
        "custom": {
          "additionalProperties": true,
          "description": "Values this generator makes no promises about.\n\n**The one open door in a deliberately closed schema, and it exists for\nthe replaced template.** `additionalProperties: false` is what\n`cpt-gearbox-fr-values-schema` asks for, and it works: an operator who\nmisspells `replicaCount` is told so. But it also refused every key a\n*house* template might read, so a site could override\n`helm/deployment.yaml` and then have nowhere to put the values that\ntemplate needed -- a corporate chart with no corporate settings.\n\nEverything outside this key stays closed. Inside it nothing is checked,\nand that is the honest bargain: Gearbox does not know what a template it\ndid not write is reading.",
          "type": "object"
        },
        "database": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "additionalProperties": false,
              "properties": {
                "existingSecret": {
                  "type": "string"

                  "type": "string"
                }
              },

                "existingSecret",

              "type": "null"

          "type": "boolean"
        },

          "description": "Name of a Secret the operator already created. Never a credential.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]

# Yours to edit. `gearbox generate` merges its changes into this file and keeps
# yours; an overlap it cannot reconcile is reported as GBX0701 and leaves the
# file untouched. See `values.generated.yaml` for what the lock decided, verbatim.

global:
  commonLabels: {}
  commonAnnotations: {}
api-gateway:
  database:
    existingSecret: configurable-db
    passwordEnv: GEARS_PG_PASSWORD
  enabled: true
  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    registry: registry.example.com/configurable
    repository: gbx-api-gateway
    tag: 0.1.0
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  serviceAccount:
    create: true
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 65532
    fsGroup: 65532
  containerSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    seccompProfile:
      type: RuntimeDefault
    capabilities:
      drop:
      - ALL
  livenessProbe:
    enabled: true
    initialDelaySeconds: 0
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold: 3
  readinessProbe:
    enabled: true
    initialDelaySeconds: 0
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold: 3
    successThreshold: 1
  startupProbe:
    enabled: false
    initialDelaySeconds: 0
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold: 30
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
  homeVolume:
    type: emptyDir
  automountServiceAccountToken: false
  tokenReview: false
  custom: {}
  secretKeys:
  - PG_HOST
  - PG_PASSWORD
